answer: One receipt settles the question, and the receipt is Charter scribe vellum sheet proof lettered across the scriptorium, written as each vellum sheet is a season of logged pen strokes plus a signed writing-master. One honest proof costs 77 POA; one farm proof costs the same, but the farm needs 347 of them, which comes to 26719 POA. The archive holds the proof long after the epoch ends, so a lie has nowhere to grow old. Behind every reef there is a workshop, behind every mirror a ledger, behind every pulse a calendar, and the farm has visited none of the three.
